backend/main.mo: Main backend canister handling access control, user approvals, admin verification, profile and report storage, and a system reset function.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that updates user profiles by promoting a specific username to admin during state upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a logout-flow fix to affected frontend files, components, and test identifiers.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of various frontend source files.
frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md: Guide for packaging the PWA as an Android app using Trusted Web Activity, including prerequisites and build steps.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment instructions for local and mainnet environments with required build versioning and post-deploy verification steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH-driven color tokens and dark mode variables for the design system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting metadata, icons, manifest reference, and mounting the main React script.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, colors, start URL, display mode, and required 192x192 and 512x512 icons.
frontend/public/sw.js: Implements a versioned service worker with precaching, runtime caching, cache cleanup, skip-waiting handling, and network-first/static-first fetch strategies.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up React Router routes, admin route guard, React Query client, and wraps the app with providers.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Displays an access denied message with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Renders the app’s top navigation bar with user info, auth actions, and admin links.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides the global layout including header, banners, content container, and footer with build info.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Controls access based on authentication and profile state, showing login, loading, pending, or profile setup screens.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Empty placeholder file for a login screen component.
frontend/src/components/OfflineBanner.ts: Shows an offline warning banner when network connectivity is lost.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Handles new user profile creation with validation, role selection, and signup requests.
frontend/src/components/ServiceWorkerUpd: Shows a banner when a new service worker version is available and lets users reload to update.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Displays a session error message with a button to reload the page.
frontend/src/components/SignupPendingAcc: UI screen showing pending account activation with retry logic that refetches the current user profile query.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to identity and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides a full logout routine clearing queries, auth storage, caches, and optionally reloading the page.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Hook to capture one-shot browser geolocation with timeout, status tracking, and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity auth client, identity loading, login, and logout state.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: Tracks online/offline status using browser events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend calls for profiles, roles, and reports with actor-aware keys.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Detects and applies service worker updates using a versioned SW URL and explicit update activation.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind layers and defines extensive light/dark theme CSS variables for colors and UI styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app root with React Query and Internet Identity provider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for listing, deleting users, viewing reports, and triggering a full system reset with dialogs and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed view of a single service report with status badges, metadata, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Provides a form to create new service reports with validation, geolocation support, and submission handling.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Shows searchable, filterable report history with optional user filtering, copying utilities, and CSV download.
frontend/src/utils/authClientIndexedDbCl: Utility that best‑effort clears Internet Identity/AuthClient IndexedDB databases to prevent automatic reauthentication after logout.
frontend/src/utils/authClientPersistentL: Creates a temporary AuthClient instance using config and logs out to clear persisted session state, swallowing errors.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Provides helpers to classify errors as missing profile, pending access, or genuine authentication failures using pattern checks.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears all localStorage and sessionStorage entries in a safe, non-throwing manner.
frontend/src/utils/buildInfo.ts: Generates a build version identifier from env variables or fallbacks and provides a display helper.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Copies text to the clipboard using the modern API or a textarea fallback and returns success status.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Formats principal IDs and usernames for display while preserving full versions when needed.
frontend/src/utils/pwaCacheCleanup.ts: Clears all Cache Storage entries and unregisters service workers with timeouts and error swallowing.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts daily service reports to CSV, generates a dated filename, and triggers a download.
Maps backend signup errors to sanitized, user-friendly messages with fallbacks for technical errors.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Sanitizes and logs signup-related events, redacting sensitive fields and patterns.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Provides basic validation for required fields, email format, and mobile number rules.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash routes), persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing them from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Defines current project state, including logout-flow fix requirements and new admin‑role feature requests for user 'sayedbaquar'.
